transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before we publish the on-call roster for Saturday's search-index rollout, I need to run through our normal readiness check. We've got Leo as primary, Marta as secondary, and Nina as escalation manager, with customer status updates every 60 minutes during any service degradation. I'd like backend engineering, infrastructure, and customer support to each review the plan and record their concrete findings. Once I've approved an operating response or follow-up for each finding, we'll be clear to publish. Personnel availability confirmations will go through the roster system separately after this. Let's start — what findings does each area have?

transcript.text:
Thank you all for these concrete findings. Let me work through each one and propose operating responses.

Ethan — Leo's expired schema-rollback access (PF1): Since Marta still has current rollback access, I'm approving an operating response that swaps the primary and secondary roles: Marta becomes primary on-call, and Leo becomes secondary. This ensures the primary on-call has rollback access without waiting on an access ticket that may not be resolved before Saturday. Ethan, please still file the access ticket so Leo's access can be restored for future rollouts.

Rina — Storage failback authorization gap (PF2): Omar is the only authorized engineer, available 1:00 AM to 5:00 AM. I'm approving an operating response that designates Omar as the storage failback engineer for the 1:00 AM to 5:00 AM window. The roster document will be corrected to remove Marta from that coverage. Rina, please update the roster document to reflect Omar and his availability window, and note that storage failback is not authorized outside that window — if failback is needed outside 1–5 AM, we escalate and hold until Omar is available.

Luis — Northstar 30-minute update requirement (PF3): I'm approving an operating response that updates the customer status update interval to every 30 minutes and assigns ownership of those updates to Customer Support. Luis, please update the rollout ticket to reflect the 30-minute interval and Support ownership.

To summarize the corrected roster: Marta as primary on-call, Leo as secondary, Nina as escalation manager, Omar as storage failback engineer from 1:00 AM to 5:00 AM, customer status updates every 30 minutes owned by Support. If there are no objections, I'll approve these responses and we'll be clear to publish once the roster system availability confirmations come through.
